== Notes ==
* Foes in [[PvE]] will attack whenever they get the chance, making this skill a very potent way to deplete foes of their energy, provided they don't [[spam]] spells or other non-attack skills.
** In case they have a tendency to spam spells or other non-attack skills, [[Disable#Skills that disable foe's skills|disabling]] those or using [[Backfire]] (in case of spells) can be a reliable way to force them into attacking. 
** This allows to trigger [[Mind Wrack]] much more easily.
* Could be combined with [[Famine]] to cause damage.
